basis: gremlins v0.6.0 default mutator set, pinned below; one gremlins run per package with that package's own tests. Test efficacy = killed / (killed + lived); timed-out, not-viable and not-covered mutants are reported outside that denominator.

exclusions.reason: Command dispatch in package main has no tests, so every mutant would be not covered; the CRAP gate tracks main.go.
Its only test file is Windows-only (command_windows_test.go), so on the Linux mutation runner every mutant would be not covered. The Windows CI leg runs that test.

Runtime cost: one run of its tests took 27 seconds at 3a4dff7 and 61 seconds in the sandbox at 82e3b72, and a dry run found 369 runnable mutants, so with 2 workers it would add an estimated 40 minutes to 3 hours, several times the 12 minutes of the rest of the scope. Its T3 expiry boundary is guarded through internal/agent's session cache.
Embedded static assets with no Go logic to mutate; the Node renderer tests cover its scripts.
